jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients through innovative antibody-based medicines. To support our biologics pipeline and portfolio, we are looking for a CMC Senior Stability Specialist in the CMC Stability department to strengthen our CMC organization with a focus on life-cycle-management activities.

**The Role and Department

**As CMC Senior Stability Specialist, you will be part of the CMC Stability department organized in CMC Development and Manufacturing. The CMC Stability department supports the Genmab portfolio from early CMC development projects to commercial products. Additionally, you will be part of and collaborate with CMC project teams

You will join a department of eight skilled and dedicated employees. In the role, you will be responsible for stability, governance of products and collaborate closely with colleagues within the department, across CMC, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Supply, and with external partners at CDMO’s/CMO’s in a highly matrixed, international environment.

Besides having extended experience with biologics and stability, the ideal candidate is statistically well-founded and can help advance the department’s data-handling capabilities.

This position will report to the Head of Department, CMC Stability.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as stability subject matter expert supporting Genmab’s biologics products.

• Ensure alignment and oversight of stability activities performed at external partners, CDMO’s/CMO’s, and internal laboratories.

• Ensure scientifically sound and regulatory-compliant stability approaches aligned with ICH guidelines and regulations.

• Perform and oversee statistical evaluation of stability data, including data handling, trend analysis and shelf-life determination.

• Author and review CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, BLA/MAA, variations).

• Support health authority interactions, e.g. be part of the request for information processes for topics related to stability.

• Be part of establishing a mature life-cycle-management set-up for commercial products.

**Requirements

**

• PhD or MSc in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, statistics, or related discipline.

• Significant experience (typically 7+ years) within CMC stability for biologics and strong knowledge of ICH guidelines, including Q1A–Q1E, Q5C, and Q6B.

• Extensive knowledge and understanding of stability for marketed biologics/clinical biological products according to current requirements and best industrial practices.

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience in statistical methods applied to stability data (e.g. regression analysis, pooling, trend analysis).

• Experience working and interacting with CDMO’s/CMO’s.

• Experience with supporting global regulatory submissions.

• Ability to translate complex scientific and statistical data into clear regulatory and business recommendations.

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• You seek and have demonstrated ability to collaborate with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to support product development programs.

• You have a structured and analytical approach when solving problems.

• Flair for IT and user software to monitor stability.

• You can manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and define steps needed to achieve project and department goals.

• You can work successfully and with integrity in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.

**What You Can Expect At Genmab

**

• A high-impact role in a science-driven organization focused on patients.

• A collaborative and inclusive culture with strong cross-functional teamwork.

• Opportunities to shape strategy and contribute to key project decisions.

• Professional growth in a global biologics company with a strong pipeline.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. jobs.occupation: Lead Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced developer interested in building high-quality software and contributing to critical applications that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.  

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment, where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.  

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC. 

Your role 

As a Lead Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative department of approximately 23 developers who design, develop and maintain the internal applications supporting our current and future business services. If you are curious about Nordic RCC and what we do, learn more about our innovative solutions on the Nordic RCC webpage. 

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape. 

You will connect technical expertise across teams, identify shared challenges, and contribute to reusable, sustainable solutions. Through cross-departmental collaboration, you will build alignment around technical opportunities, constraints, and impacts across the organization. 

What you will do :  

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization  

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems  

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:  

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  
C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python  

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  
Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs 

• 
Databases & storage 
Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3 

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  
Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX  

• 
Tooling and collaboration  
Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines  

We’re looking for someone with:  

• 
Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus. 

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.   

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace  

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.  

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   

Application deadline and contact information  

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling  basis up until the right candidate has been found.  

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.  

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111.

jobs.occupation: Deciphering host-pathogen interplay by utilizing biostructure prediction and New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) to engineer durable disease resistance in plants
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Agroecology programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Deciphering host-pathogen interplay by utilizing biostructure prediction and New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) to engineer durable disease resistance in plants

Research area and project description
The Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University is offering a PhD position focused on genetic modification of plants for higher resistance to pathogens. The position is available from 01-02-2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

The PhD is part of the project that aims to develop novel and durable disease resistance in cereals by targeting key protein–protein interactions between plants and pathogens. Using hexaploid wheat (Triticum aestivum) and diploid barley (Hordeum vulgare) as model systems, the project will focus on
powdery mildew disease caused by Blumeria graminis f. sp. tritici (Bgt) and B. hordei (Bh).

The PhD student will establish and optimize an AI-based structural biology modelling and prime editing toolbox and apply it to introduce genome modification in vitro culture. These edits are designed to disrupt critical plant-pathogen protein interactions, thereby enhancing disease resistance without relying on classical resistance genes. Computational prediction tools, including AlphaFold-based protein-protein interaction modeling, will be used to guide target selection and interpret the molecular effects of the edits. Wheat transformation will be carried out in three varieties with contrasting resistance profiles, and barley transformation will be done in Golden Promise. Disease resistance will be assessed through controlled inoculation experiments. Edited and wild-type plants will be inoculated with Blumeria graminis isolates and evaluated at the whole-plant level.

Overall, the project aims to establish a new resistance concept based on blocking essential plant-pathogen interactions rather than relying on single resistance genes. This strategy has the potential to deliver more robust and durable disease resistance and to open new avenues for precision breeding in cereal crops.

The position is funded by a project supported by the DFF, in collaboration with Copenhagen University and will last 3 years.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant MSc degree within molecular biology, plant or agricultural sciences, biology, biotechnology or similar.
• Knowledge in plant transformation and in vitro culture
• Experience with Alphafold and/or structural biology.
• Be fluent in English (written and spoken).
• Have scientific writing and communication skills.
• Have the ability to manage your own tasks and collaborate in an international research team.
Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Agroecology, Forsøgsvej 1, 4200 Slagelse, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Kim Hebelstrup, e-mail: Kim.hebelstrup@agro.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Olga A. Oxholm, e-mail: olgaa@agro.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 09 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

**Turn complexity into one plan the business can act on.

****What if planning could shape the future, not just react to it?

**Across the Nordics, demand is shaped by tenders, contracts, launches and changing customer needs. The opportunity is to bring those signals together early, translate them into clear choices and create a healthier balance between product availability and inventory. That is where you come in.

As our Demand & Supply Manager Nordics, you will create one reliable view of demand and supply across Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. You will own the Nordic Sales and Operations Planning cycle, lead a distributed planning team and help move the organization from reactive expediting towards confident, forward-looking decisions.

**Your impact

****Role

**This is not a role where you simply maintain a forecast. You will set the direction for how the Nordics plan, decide and improve. You will:

• Own one Nordic demand and supply plan, bringing tender and contract intelligence into the forecast early enough to influence decisions.

• Lead the full S&OP cycle, from portfolio and demand reviews through supply and management review, with clear monthly decisions and ownership.

• Take accountability for inventory health, availability and the working-capital effect of the plan, while preventing excess and risk stock from rebuilding.

• Lead and develop four planners and one analyst across Denmark, Sweden and Finland, creating one way of working that is resilient across countries and absences.

• Connect sales, category, tender, sourcing, finance, warehouse and transport around the same facts, priorities and actions.

**What Will Make You Successful

**You combine strong planning craft with practical leadership. You are comfortable moving between item-level detail and senior stakeholder decisions, and you know how to challenge constructively when the numbers tell a different story.

**You Are Likely To Bring

**

• 8-12 years in supply chain, including at least five years in demand and supply planning or S&OP.

• Experience owning a full S&OP or IBP cycle and leading a planning team, ideally across more than one country.

• Strong knowledge of inventory, working capital, forecast quality and excess or obsolete stock.

• Hands-on experience with an advanced planning system such as Slim4, o9, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or a comparable platform, plus strong Excel or BI skills.

• Professional English and, preferably, Danish or Swedish.

• A relevant Bachelor or Master degree. APICS, IBF or an equivalent certification is an advantage.

**The environment you will step into

**The scope is genuinely Nordic and the mandate is broad. You will have the space to shape the process while keeping the daily business moving.

You will work closely on standards, tools and the group excess and risk stock process. Your influence will reach well beyond your direct team, so trust, clarity and follow-through will matter as much as technical expertise.

**Ready to build what comes next?

**If you want to lead a cross-border team, create one Nordic planning approach and turn better demand and supply decisions into stronger service and healthier inventory, we would like to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark or Kungsbacka Sweden. Travel: Regular travel within the Nordics and Europe is part of the role.

**Apply and help shape one Nordic view of demand and supply

**Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to this next chapter of Nordic planning.

**About Mediq

**Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services, and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics, and home care, we ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq we offer jobs that change lives, join us.

The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on.

We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it.

Tech stack you will be working with

• C# and .NET, TypeScript, React

• AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

• Event driven services and large scale data pipelines

• GitHub Actions for CI and CD

• Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC

What we will be doing

• Contribute to the technical direction of the team. Write the system designs for the work you own, take part in design reviews, and argue for the option you believe is right.

• Design and build systems yourself: services, APIs and data pipelines that stay stable, fast and affordable as data volumes grow.

• Lead our use of AI across the product development lifecycle. Take a product requirements document to a technical vision and system designs, break it into epics and user stories that an agent can act on, and set the standard at each step.

• Improve the scaffolding that makes agent driven delivery work: context and instruction files, prompts and skills, and the review and testing practice that keeps quality high when code arrives faster than before.

• Keep search data trustworthy, with tests, monitoring and errors a colleague can understand.

• Define how we measure quality, detect drift, and explain results to customers who make decisions based on them.

• Mentor engineers at all levels through design reviews, pairing and written technical proposals, including how to work well with agents.

• Treat cost, performance and operability as design inputs from the start.

• Take part in the daily work of the team: refinement, estimation, prototyping, debugging and production support.

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.

• 10 or more years of professional software development experience.

• 5 or more years building and running services and APIs on a public cloud, preferably AWS.

• A track record of architecture decisions that span several teams, including the trade offs you rejected and why.

• You have owned features or services end to end, including what happened after they were released.

• Hands on experience using coding agents in real production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they do not.

• Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms and data structures, and a commitment to technical excellence.

• Excellent written and verbal English. You write proposals and designs that other people, and agents, can act on without a meeting.

• Willingness to work across the stack when the problem calls for it.

What we will love about you

• Experience turning product requirements into technical designs and a delivery plan that a team can execute.

• Experience with search, SEO, crawling, indexing, ranking or web scale data.

• Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• Experience working in a team distributed across Europe and North America.

• You take pride in the work of the team and lead by example.

• You are comfortable replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

What you'll love about usWe’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.

Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.

Prepare for the future: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

In this role, you'll:

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Beyond that, you'll bring:

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• 
Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• 
A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• 
Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• 
A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• 
Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• 
AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• 
A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• 
Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• 
A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• 
Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• 
Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer leading energy-efficient solutions that accelerate the green transition and shape a more sustainable tomorrow. As our new Technical Product & Portfolio Manager, you will play a pivotal role at the intersection of business strategy and technology, turning emerging opportunities into high-impact, revenue-generating solutions.

By connecting strategic vision with practical execution, you will drive customer-centric innovation, transforming existing offerings and unlocking new business models across growth domains such as Data Center Cooling, Digital Services, and Connected Infrastructure Solutions.

Working within the Digital Application Solutions team, you will collaborate closely with business leaders, domain experts, R&D, and engineering teams to identify new opportunities, shape portfolio priorities, and bring concepts from exploration through implementation to deliver measurable business impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive Business-Led Innovation: Identify and assess high-potential business challenges and market opportunities, building business cases and revenue models.

• Shape the Digital Portfolio: Own and refine the Digital Application Solutions portfolio, roadmaps, backlogs, dependencies, and key decisions.

• Modernize & Expand Offerings: Create new digital value propositions from existing Danfoss products and services to reach new markets.

• Act as the Core Connector: Bridge leadership, business stakeholders, R&D, domain experts, and engineering teams to align goals and direction.

• Accelerate Delivery: Drive progress from exploration and validation to implementation, delivering measurable results in weeks to months.

• Frame & Structure Concepts: Turn complex ideas into clear opportunities, hypotheses, trade-offs, and actionable next steps.

• Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with leadership on executive communication, representing the team with confidence and transparency.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong Commercial Mindset: Assess market potential, customer value, and ROI while balancing commercial and technical perspectives.

• Product & Portfolio Experience: Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Owner, or Portfolio Manager leading digital solutions from discovery to delivery.

• Domain & Digital Familiarity: Experience or strong interest in digital services, IoT, cloud solutions, connected products, and industrial applications.

• Exceptional Structuring Skills: Bring clarity, focus, and direction to complex and ambiguous challenges.

• Proactive Communicator: Excel at stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and team representation.

• Outcome-Driven Execution: Deliver measurable business results by driving progress, prioritizing effectively, and managing trade-offs.

• Education & Language: Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar, with fluent professional English.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**About Us

**Do you wish to join the House of Dreams?

In this House, you will continue to perpetuate the dream of our creator: that of a more beautiful and happier world.

You will also consolidate our vision: to become the most desirable House in the world of beauty, an absolute reference of French luxury, a symbol of joy and hope.

This Vision Is Carried By Our Six Values That You Will Embody Daily As Designers Of Dreams - Values That Engage And Define Us

_Create Passionately

__Craft together with joy

__Excel for ultimate luxury

__Lead with audacity

__Cultivate Triumphant inclusivity

__Commit and act to re-enchant the world.

__**Design your dreams with Dior.

**_**Your Impact

**As Training Manager, you have the pivotal mission to embody and champion the exquisite heritage and brand values of DIOR while driving the development of human capital (Beauty Consultants, Promoters, Generic Staff) and retail excellence across PCD's doors within a dynamic travel retail environment.

Fostering a culture of continuous learning and outstanding client experience, you inspire and equip retail teams with the skills, knowledge and mindset needed to deliver on both collective and individual performance objectives. A true learning strategist, you design and deploy multi-faceted training programs and action plans that empower teams to over-achieve their POS objectives while nurturing strong performers and future people developers.

You play an essential role as the key link between the field (70% of your time) and HQ stakeholders, translating business priorities into impactful learning solutions across the following three key areas: Beauty Consultants coaching, In-class and digital trainings and Seminars.

Position

**BEAUTY CONSULTANTS COACHING

**

• Design and deploy a structured and progressive training curriculum covering product knowledge, brand heritage, makeup artistry, skincare expertise and advanced selling techniques, together with the Retail Manager in your region

• Track and measure knowledge acquisition through regular quizzes, certifications and practical assessments,

• Conduct individual appraisals at regular intervals, delivering clear, constructive and motivating feedback to each Beauty Consultant

• Build and monitor personalized Individual Development Plans for each Beauty Consultant, setting SMART objectives and milestones to track progress over time

• Oversee BC uniform and grooming allocation to ensure every BC is impeccably equipped at all times
